changelog.change: Initial derived-wordlist registry: the anagram set, cut from the ranked master at 3-6 ezhuthu, common/mid bands, co-anagram required.
changelog.why: Row 9 - adding another Game's wordlist must be a data change plus a re-run, never a code rewrite (the corpus and the daily puzzle are different layers).

sets.note: 3-6 ezhuthu keeps a scramble solvable on a phone in a 2-minute burst (2 tiles has one wrong arrangement, which is a coin flip and not a puzzle). common+mid are the ranks a Tamil speaker actually knows; the rare band is a dictionary lookup, not a guess. requireCoAnagram is the unscramble-tension rule: the tiles must rearrange into at least one other real master word.
